scientific_intent.scientific_task: Evaluate fixed-shape ResNet-style channel-preserving Winograd3x3 and channel-reducing/expanding1x1 convolution operators with affine batch-normalization parameters and mode-specific ReLU.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Winograd F(4x4,3x3): BT*d*B,36 independent channel GEMMs, AT*M*A, then perchannel scale/bias/ReLU. Four1x1 matrix products512->128,128->512,1024->256,256->1024 with affine and ReLU only on reducing paths; output paths intentionally linear.
scientific_intent.discretization: All six original source modes and full source14x14 feature region; Winograd stores16x16 feature maps and4x4 output tiles with lasttile croppedto2. Named deterministic seed20261018, signed dyadic input/weights/scales/biases, nonzero source padded borders. Original16x16 allocation is extended by34 initializedzero channelvectors for defined source-stride16 patch reads.

scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Original feature dimensions and channels, no downscaled proxy; named synthetic parameters rather than original binary files/randomseed. Three complete launches/path for Winograd and one/path for1x1;3 repetitions perpath,5outertrials mean2-5. Does not include six-mode CLI host file IO/allocation/offload timing or full inference graph.
